acip: RNA BA GA-YAS GA-YON GNYIS KYI RDO RJE'I BAR NAS RE RE YOD PA THABS BDE BA CHE PO MTSON, THOD SKAM GYI RTZER RNAM SNANG DBUS SU YOD PA'I RGYAL BA RIGS LNGA MTHA' PA TRAS BSKOR BA'I RTZE PHRAN 'PHANG SOR LNGA YOD PA RE RE'ANG RIGS LNGA'I BDAG NYID YIN PA MTSON PA DANG, CHOS SKU LAS GZUGS SKUR BZHENGS PA'ANG MTSON,
wylie: rna ba ga-yas ga-yon gnyis kyi rdo rje'i bar nas re re yod pa thabs bde ba che po mtshon, thod skam gyi rtser rnam snang dbus su yod pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga mtha' pa tras bskor ba'i rtse phran 'phang sor lnga yod pa re re'ang rigs lnga'i bdag nyid yin pa mtshon pa dang, chos sku las gzugs skur bzhengs pa'ang mtshon
english: Between the diamond bolts at Her left and right ears there is another skull each, which represents method: great bliss.  On top of each dry skull, in the center, is the Angel named Appearances; and around Him are the Buddhas of the five families circled on the outside like an endless knot, tiny points around the main point, five fingerwidths high, each of the other points representing a combination of all five of these Buddhas.  This also represents the fact that the Form Body rises out of the Dharma Body.
